not_a_service: This is a shape fixture for the Caravan product shell. It is not a deployed customer service, not a release, and not a reading of any real corridor. Every identifier begins with FIXTURE- so it cannot be mistaken for one.
why_no_corridor: Caravan's v1 slice — mode, corridor, geography — is undecided (LINE-007). A fixture that named one would be inventing the decision, so this fixture demonstrates response shape and truth classes on abstract identifiers instead.

release.whyUnknown: Release identity is specified but not built; nothing issues a release yet, so no response can be release-bound.

limitations: Coverage is the evidence state of this slice, not a quality score.
A subject with no evidence is counted as uncovered, never as clean.
